card.name: Dragão Revólver
card.summary: Uma vez por turno: escolha 1 monstro que o oponente controla e lance 3 moedas. Se pelo menos 2 derem cara, destrua o alvo.

textEvidence.text: Once per turn per face-up copy, in its controller’s Main Phase, target one opposing monster, including a face-down monster. Resolve three coin tosses and destroy that same target only if at least two are heads. Zero or one head does nothing. No cost. If the target leaves, a new target cannot be chosen. Negation prevents the tosses and destruction.

card.name: Dragão Solta Fogo
card.summary: Uma vez por turno: escolha 1 carta que o oponente controla e lance 3 moedas. Se pelo menos 2 derem cara, destrua o alvo.

textEvidence.text: Once per turn per face-up copy, in its controller’s Main Phase, target one opposing card anywhere on the field, including a Set Spell, Trap or Field Spell. Resolve three coin tosses and destroy that same target only if at least two are heads. Zero or one head does nothing. No cost. If the target leaves, a new target cannot be chosen. Negation prevents the tosses and destruction.
